$schema_note: Crystal Meets — meet catalog. Field-per-record schema for future CMS mapping (Sanity/Payload/Directus). Image URLs may point to external CDN or /assets/meets/<id>.jpg once static assets are hosted.

$fields.name: string (required) — display title
$fields.date_offset_days: int — days from today for demo seed; real records use ISO 'date' field instead
$fields.date: ISO datetime string — canonical field for production records
$fields.hour: int (0-23) — used with date_offset_days for demo seed

meets.name: Mondello Park Trackday
meets.description: Full circuit trackday at Ireland's national motor racing venue. Novice, intermediate and advanced sessions. Bring your helmet, road cars welcome.
meets.address: Mondello Park, Caragh, Naas, Co. Kildare, Ireland

meets.name: Dublin Cars & Coffee — Ringsend
meets.description: Sunday morning cars & coffee at the Point Village. Coffee vans on site, family friendly, all makes welcome.
meets.address: Point Village, North Wall Quay, Dublin 1

meets.name: JDM Night — Sandyford Industrial
meets.description: Late-night JDM meet. Skylines, Supras, Silvias, EVOs and STIs welcome. Strict no-burnout policy — bring the vibes not the heat.

meets.name: Killarney Historic Rally
meets.description: Stages weekend through the Kerry mountains. Spectator points marked. Warm clothing essential — mountain weather changes fast.

meets.name: Cork German Car Society Meet
meets.description: Monthly German car meet. BMW M-series, Audi RS, Porsche, Mercedes-AMG. Ballincollig Regional Park car park.

meets.name: Charity Drive for Temple Street
meets.description: Convoy drive from Punchestown to Powerscourt. €20 entry per car — 100% to Temple Street Children's Hospital. All makes welcome.

meets.name: Mondello Park Drift Day
meets.description: Full-day drift session on the National Circuit. Novices welcome, tuition available. Tyre wall on paddock side. Spectators free.
meets.address: Mondello Park, Caragh, Naas, Co. Kildare

meets.name: Galway Classic & Vintage Show
meets.description: Salthill promenade classics show. Pre-1990 cars welcome. Trophies for Best in Show, Best Restored, and People's Choice.

meets.name: Supercar Sunday — Kilternan
meets.description: Hypercar and supercar gathering. Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Porsche GT. Coffee on site, photographers welcome.

meets.name: Belfast Cars & Coffee — Titanic Quarter
meets.description: Cross-border C&C at the Titanic Quarter. Northern and Southern registrations welcome. Family friendly, food trucks.

meets.name: Waterford Rally Sprint
meets.description: Single-stage sprint rally at Tramore Racecourse. Great for spectators — full lap visible from the grandstand.

meets.name: Limerick JDM & Euro Meet
meets.description: Combined JDM + Euro meet at the University of Limerick car park. Static show — no revving after 9pm please, respect the neighbours.
